involves.heading: What Electrical Service Involves
involves.body: Electrical service covers everything from a single outlet repair to a full panel replacement, and the right scope depends on what's actually going on with your system. Electrical wiring services address problems inside walls and ceilings, while an electrical panel handles how power is distributed to every circuit in your home, so panel issues tend to affect multiple rooms at once. Carolina Heating Service provides:
bullets: Electrical wiring and rewiring services for renovations, repairs, and older homes
Electrical panel upgrades and replacement for added capacity and safety
Electrical lighting maintenance and repair for fixtures, switches, and outlets
Specialty electrical services including EV charger installation, ceiling fans, and circuit breakers

signs.heading: Signs You Need an Electrical Panel Upgrade or Replacement
signs.body: Frequently tripped breakers, flickering or dimming lights when appliances turn on, warm or discolored outlets, and a panel that's more than 20 to 25 years old are all signs it's time for an inspection. If you're planning an addition, a major appliance upgrade, or an EV charger installation, checking whether your panel has enough capacity before you commit to the upgrade can save you from a bigger problem later.
